lessons.correction: Continue strengthening your ground army and maintain economy. Consider expanding further to secure long-term advantage.
lessons.mistake: Investing in unnecessary technology that delays army production.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when you have more information about opponent's army composition or when they make a move. Exit when you have a clear strategic direction.
lessons.title: Avoid premature tech investment
lessons.when: Early-mid game, opponent has ground posture with Zerglings, heavy economy, and you have moderate production and light tech.
lessons.why: Both sides focus on economy and ground forces; the better economy and army composition will prevail.

lessons.correction: Maintain a balanced approach: develop economy while strengthening ground army. Focus on scouting to gain information.
lessons.mistake: Making unnecessary units that could be drones, falling behind economically.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when you have more information about opponent's army composition or when they make a move. Exit when you have a clear strategic direction.
lessons.title: Avoid falling behind in economy
lessons.when: Early game, opponent has ground posture with Queen, your economy is moderate, and you have light tech.
lessons.why: Opponent focuses on economy; you need to keep up economically while building a defensive army to deter attacks. Balanced approach adapts to opponent's actions.
